mapper.insert: INSERT INTO positions (account_id, symbol, quantity, average_cost, version) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{quantity}, #{averageCost}, #{version} )
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, symbol, quantity, average_cost, version, created_at, last_updated, updated_by FROM positions WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY symbol
mapper.update: UPDATE positions SET quantity = #{quantity}, average_cost = #{averageCost}, version = version + 1, last_updated = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM positions WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND symbol = #{symbol}
